sources.snippet: 400M-param Danish LM, SFT'd on a 9-source mix. Successor to danish-lm-400m-sft-v4 — same base, same optimizer, only change is upgrading the instruction-following dataset from IF-v1 → IF-v2 (150 render variants, 5-way combos, held-out eval).
